function formatGCalDate(d) {
    var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    return d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate()) +
           'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes()) + '00';
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = null;
    var parent = e.target;

    while (parent) {
        if (parent.classList && parent.classList.contains('gcal-loop-btn')) {
            btn = parent;
            break;
        }
        parent = parent.parentElement;
    }

    if (!btn) return;

    // Find the loop item card
    var card = btn.parentElement;
    while (card) {
        if (card.classList && card.classList.contains('e-loop-item')) break;
        card = card.parentElement;
    }

    if (!card) return;

    // Read title
var titleEl = card.querySelector('.elementor-element-adf4ad1 .elementor-heading-title');
    var title   = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Webinar';

    // Read raw start datetime: "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var startRawEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-start-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var startRaw   = startRawEl ? startRawEl.textContent.trim() : '';

    // Read timezone
    var tzEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-timezone-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var tz   = tzEl ? tzEl.textContent.trim() : 'Asia/Kolkata';

    if (!startRaw) return;

    // Parse "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var parts   = startRaw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
    if (!parts) return;

    var year   = Number(parts[1]);
    var month  = Number(parts[2]);
    var day    = Number(parts[3]);
    var hour   = Number(parts[4]);
    var minute = Number(parts[5]);

    // Convert zoned time to UTC (same logic you already use)
    var utcGuess = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0));

    var formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: tz,
        year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
    });

    var formatted = formatter.formatToParts(utcGuess);
    var map = {};
    formatted.forEach(function(p) {
        if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });

    var asIfUtc = Date.UTC(
        Number(map.year), Number(map.month) - 1, Number(map.day),
        Number(map.hour), Number(map.minute), Number(map.second)
    );

    var eventUtc  = new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - (asIfUtc - Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0)));
    var eventEnd  = new Date(eventUtc.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000)); // default 1 hour duration

    var startStr = formatGCalDate(eventUtc);
    var endStr   = formatGCalDate(eventEnd);

    var calURL =
        'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
        '&text='    + encodeURIComponent(title) +
        '&dates='   + startStr + '/' + endStr +
        '&details=' + encodeURIComponent('You have successfully registered for: ' + title) +
        '&sf=true&output=xml';

    window.open(calURL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');

					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',

function formatGCalDate(d) {
    var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    return d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate()) +
           'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes()) + '00';
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = null;
    var parent = e.target;

    while (parent) {
        if (parent.classList && parent.classList.contains('gcal-loop-btn')) {
            btn = parent;
            break;
        }
        parent = parent.parentElement;
    }

    if (!btn) return;

    // Find the loop item card
    var card = btn.parentElement;
    while (card) {
        if (card.classList && card.classList.contains('e-loop-item')) break;
        card = card.parentElement;
    }

    if (!card) return;

    // Read title
var titleEl = card.querySelector('.elementor-element-adf4ad1 .elementor-heading-title');
    var title   = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Webinar';

    // Read raw start datetime: "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var startRawEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-start-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var startRaw   = startRawEl ? startRawEl.textContent.trim() : '';

    // Read timezone
    var tzEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-timezone-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var tz   = tzEl ? tzEl.textContent.trim() : 'Asia/Kolkata';

    if (!startRaw) return;

    // Parse "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var parts   = startRaw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
    if (!parts) return;

    var year   = Number(parts[1]);
    var month  = Number(parts[2]);
    var day    = Number(parts[3]);
    var hour   = Number(parts[4]);
    var minute = Number(parts[5]);

    // Convert zoned time to UTC (same logic you already use)
    var utcGuess = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0));

    var formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: tz,
        year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
    });

    var formatted = formatter.formatToParts(utcGuess);
    var map = {};
    formatted.forEach(function(p) {
        if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });

    var asIfUtc = Date.UTC(
        Number(map.year), Number(map.month) - 1, Number(map.day),
        Number(map.hour), Number(map.minute), Number(map.second)
    );

    var eventUtc  = new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - (asIfUtc - Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0)));
    var eventEnd  = new Date(eventUtc.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000)); // default 1 hour duration

    var startStr = formatGCalDate(eventUtc);
    var endStr   = formatGCalDate(eventEnd);

    var calURL =
        'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
        '&text='    + encodeURIComponent(title) +
        '&dates='   + startStr + '/' + endStr +
        '&details=' + encodeURIComponent('You have successfully registered for: ' + title) +
        '&sf=true&output=xml';

    window.open(calURL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
});

  const triggerPoint = 10;
  let menuOpen = false;

  function updateHeaderState() {
    if (window.scrollY > triggerPoint || menuOpen) {
      header.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      header.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateHeaderState);

  if (menuItems.length) {

      item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
        menuOpen = true;
        updateHeaderState();
      });
      item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
        menuOpen = false;
        updateHeaderState();
      });
    });
  }
});

function formatGCalDate(d) {
    var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    return d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate()) +
           'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes()) + '00';
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = null;
    var parent = e.target;

    while (parent) {
        if (parent.classList && parent.classList.contains('gcal-loop-btn')) {
            btn = parent;
            break;
        }
        parent = parent.parentElement;
    }

    if (!btn) return;

    // Find the loop item card
    var card = btn.parentElement;
    while (card) {
        if (card.classList && card.classList.contains('e-loop-item')) break;
        card = card.parentElement;
    }

    if (!card) return;

    // Read title
var titleEl = card.querySelector('.elementor-element-adf4ad1 .elementor-heading-title');
    var title   = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Webinar';

    // Read raw start datetime: "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var startRawEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-start-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var startRaw   = startRawEl ? startRawEl.textContent.trim() : '';

    // Read timezone
    var tzEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-timezone-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var tz   = tzEl ? tzEl.textContent.trim() : 'Asia/Kolkata';

    if (!startRaw) return;

    // Parse "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var parts   = startRaw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
    if (!parts) return;

    var year   = Number(parts[1]);
    var month  = Number(parts[2]);
    var day    = Number(parts[3]);
    var hour   = Number(parts[4]);
    var minute = Number(parts[5]);

    // Convert zoned time to UTC (same logic you already use)
    var utcGuess = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0));

    var formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: tz,
        year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
    });

    var formatted = formatter.formatToParts(utcGuess);
    var map = {};
    formatted.forEach(function(p) {
        if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });

    var asIfUtc = Date.UTC(
        Number(map.year), Number(map.month) - 1, Number(map.day),
        Number(map.hour), Number(map.minute), Number(map.second)
    );

    var eventUtc  = new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - (asIfUtc - Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0)));
    var eventEnd  = new Date(eventUtc.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000)); // default 1 hour duration

    var startStr = formatGCalDate(eventUtc);
    var endStr   = formatGCalDate(eventEnd);

    var calURL =
        'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
        '&text='    + encodeURIComponent(title) +
        '&dates='   + startStr + '/' + endStr +
        '&details=' + encodeURIComponent('You have successfully registered for: ' + title) +
        '&sf=true&output=xml';

    window.open(calURL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
});

function formatGCalDate(d) {
    var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    return d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate()) +
           'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes()) + '00';
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = null;
    var parent = e.target;

    while (parent) {
        if (parent.classList && parent.classList.contains('gcal-loop-btn')) {
            btn = parent;
            break;
        }
        parent = parent.parentElement;
    }

    if (!btn) return;

    // Find the loop item card
    var card = btn.parentElement;
    while (card) {
        if (card.classList && card.classList.contains('e-loop-item')) break;
        card = card.parentElement;
    }

    if (!card) return;

    // Read title
var titleEl = card.querySelector('.elementor-element-adf4ad1 .elementor-heading-title');
    var title   = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Webinar';

    // Read raw start datetime: "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var startRawEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-start-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var startRaw   = startRawEl ? startRawEl.textContent.trim() : '';

    // Read timezone
    var tzEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-timezone-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var tz   = tzEl ? tzEl.textContent.trim() : 'Asia/Kolkata';

    if (!startRaw) return;

    // Parse "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var parts   = startRaw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
    if (!parts) return;

    var year   = Number(parts[1]);
    var month  = Number(parts[2]);
    var day    = Number(parts[3]);
    var hour   = Number(parts[4]);
    var minute = Number(parts[5]);

    // Convert zoned time to UTC (same logic you already use)
    var utcGuess = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0));

    var formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: tz,
        year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
    });

    var formatted = formatter.formatToParts(utcGuess);
    var map = {};
    formatted.forEach(function(p) {
        if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });

    var asIfUtc = Date.UTC(
        Number(map.year), Number(map.month) - 1, Number(map.day),
        Number(map.hour), Number(map.minute), Number(map.second)
    );

    var eventUtc  = new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - (asIfUtc - Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0)));
    var eventEnd  = new Date(eventUtc.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000)); // default 1 hour duration

    var startStr = formatGCalDate(eventUtc);
    var endStr   = formatGCalDate(eventEnd);

    var calURL =
        'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
        '&text='    + encodeURIComponent(title) +
        '&dates='   + startStr + '/' + endStr +
        '&details=' + encodeURIComponent('You have successfully registered for: ' + title) +
        '&sf=true&output=xml';

    window.open(calURL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
});

<script>
function formatGCalDate(d) {
    var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    return d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate()) +
           'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes()) + '00';
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = null;
    var parent = e.target;

    while (parent) {
        if (parent.classList && parent.classList.contains('gcal-loop-btn')) {
            btn = parent;
            break;
        }
        parent = parent.parentElement;
    }

    if (!btn) return;

    // Find the loop item card
    var card = btn.parentElement;
    while (card) {
        if (card.classList && card.classList.contains('e-loop-item')) break;
        card = card.parentElement;
    }

    if (!card) return;

    // Read title
var titleEl = card.querySelector('.elementor-element-adf4ad1 .elementor-heading-title');
    var title   = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Webinar';

    // Read raw start datetime: "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var startRawEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-start-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var startRaw   = startRawEl ? startRawEl.textContent.trim() : '';

    // Read timezone
    var tzEl = card.querySelector('.webinar-timezone-raw .elementor-heading-title');
    var tz   = tzEl ? tzEl.textContent.trim() : 'Asia/Kolkata';

    if (!startRaw) return;

    // Parse "2025-08-20 15:30:00"
    var parts   = startRaw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
    if (!parts) return;

    var year   = Number(parts[1]);
    var month  = Number(parts[2]);
    var day    = Number(parts[3]);
    var hour   = Number(parts[4]);
    var minute = Number(parts[5]);

    // Convert zoned time to UTC (same logic you already use)
    var utcGuess = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0));

    var formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: tz,
        year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
    });

    var formatted = formatter.formatToParts(utcGuess);
    var map = {};
    formatted.forEach(function(p) {
        if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });

    var asIfUtc = Date.UTC(
        Number(map.year), Number(map.month) - 1, Number(map.day),
        Number(map.hour), Number(map.minute), Number(map.second)
    );

    var eventUtc  = new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - (asIfUtc - Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0)));
    var eventEnd  = new Date(eventUtc.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000)); // default 1 hour duration

    var startStr = formatGCalDate(eventUtc);
    var endStr   = formatGCalDate(eventEnd);

    var calURL =
        'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
        '&text='    + encodeURIComponent(title) +
        '&dates='   + startStr + '/' + endStr +
        '&details=' + encodeURIComponent('You have successfully registered for: ' + title) +
        '&sf=true&output=xml';

    window.open(calURL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
});
